title: Product Details
description: One product's page section, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Carousel, NumberInput, RadioGroup, Skeleton, Spinner and Tabs primitives: a Carousel gallery of the product's photos, its serif name and price, a short description, one RadioGroup per option (colour, size…) with sold-out values off, a NumberInput for the quantity and an Add to cart button that reports the selection, then Tabs for details, care and shipping, with its own adding, sold-out, loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the quantity and the button share a row at @sm, the name steps up at @md, and the gallery moves beside the details at @lg.
